tagline: Advancing audio and video entertainment through innovative technology licensing
hero_kpi_rationale: Licensing revenue represents the majority of the company's revenue and directly reflects the adoption of its audio and video technologies by global consumer electronics manufacturers

kpis.name: Licensing Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from licensing audio and video technologies to electronics manufacturers
kpis.description: Total licensing revenue for audio and video technologies

kpis.name: Branded Technology Licensing
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from licensing branded audio and video technologies (Dolby Atmos, Dolby Vision, audio codecs)
kpis.description: Licensing revenue for branded audio and video technologies to device manufacturers

kpis.name: Patent Licensing
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from participation in standardized patent pools (AAC, HE-AAC, AVC, HEVC)
kpis.description: Licensing revenue for audio and video patents through standardized patent pools

kpis.name: Adoption of Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos
kpis.explanation: Number of content titles (films, TV series, live sports) produced and distributed in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos
kpis.description: Growing adoption of Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos by major studios and streaming platforms (Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV, Amazon, HBO Max, Paramount+, Peacock) as well as in live sports events

risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic conditions may negatively impact the company's revenue, including due to the financial health of licensees, inflation, high interest rates, foreign exchange fluctuations, material and transportation costs, tariffs, and trade barriers.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including vulnerabilities in its systems and data. An experienced CISO oversees a team of security professionals, and the board of directors provides direct oversight.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, where firms must compete to attract and retain customers and drive adoption of standardized technologies.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in diplomatic and trade relations, trade protection measures including tariffs, and import or export licensing requirements may negatively impact the company's revenue.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in legal proceedings and disputes, which may negatively affect its revenue and reputation.

risks.title: Reputational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must protect its reputation and maintain the trust of its customers and partners. Dolby is a brand synonymous with high quality in entertainment.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations and laws may negatively impact the company's operations and revenue, particularly regarding enforcement of intellectual property rights.

ai_positioning.summary: DLB does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F filing.
